taskDescription: Arrange the PPE doffing (removal) steps in the correct order. Remember: remove the most contaminated items first.
paragraphs: Remove gloves — peel off from the outside, turning inside out to contain contamination
Remove eye protection — handle only by the headband or earpieces, not the front surface
Remove gown — unfasten ties, peel away from neck and shoulders, turning inside out
Remove mask or respirator — handle only by the ties or elastic bands, never touch the front
Perform hand hygiene immediately after all PPE is removed
